findings.title: Burst or tap at long range
findings.summary: 2 of your 2 sprays of 6+ bullets beyond 1,200 units hit nothing after bullet 4 (100 %); 9 bullets went nowhere.
findings.why: Past the first bullets the spread and recoil are wider than a body at that range; those bullets only tell the enemy where you are and empty your magazine.

advice.text: Beyond 1,200 units fire bursts of 2–3 bullets and let the recoil reset between them, or tap the head.
advice.drill: 5 minutes on a long-range bot map: 3-bullet bursts at 30+ m, wait for the crosshair to settle each time.

findings.title: Use your grenades before you die
findings.summary: You died 2 times with 2 or more grenades left in rounds your team lost ($1,000 unused); over the match $189 of grenades a round went unused (8th of 10).
findings.why: Grenades left on a dead player helped nobody; thrown, they could have delayed, damaged or blinded.

advice.text: When you hold an angle, throw your molotov or HE at the first sound of contact instead of waiting for the perfect moment.
Before a peek you might not survive, throw what you carry first.

findings.title: Play where a teammate can trade you
findings.summary: 4 of your 6 deaths (67 %) came with no teammate within 900 units and went untraded; your team lost 4 of those 4 rounds. At death your nearest teammate was 1,118 units away on median (7th of 10).
findings.why: A death nobody can trade is a free kill: your team is a player down with nothing back.

advice.text: Before you take a fight, check the radar: if no teammate could swing within a few seconds, fall back or wait for one.
When you lurk or hold alone, play for information and survival, not for the first duel.

findings.title: Buy with your team
findings.summary: In 2 of 8 rounds your buy went against 3 or more teammates: 2 times you bought while they saved (tied 9th of 10).
findings.why: A lone buy is wasted with four players on pistols, and a lone save leaves four rifles a player short; next round the money is out of step again.

advice.text: Ask for the buy before the round ("full buy", "save") and follow the call even when your own money says otherwise; drop or ask for a weapon instead.

findings.title: Complete your loadout
findings.summary: 3 of your 5 gun rounds had a hole in the loadout: 3 as CT without a kit you could afford ($400); 1 with a rifle and no armor; 2 full buys with over $1,000 left and 2 or fewer grenades (7th of 10).
findings.why: No kit loses retakes on time, no armor turns body shots into kills, and money left in the bank does nothing this round.

advice.text: Finish every gun buy in the same order: armor, gun, kit (CT), then grenades until the money or the slots run out.
